content: A ku tɔn kɔ̃sobun wɑ̃ɑru binɛ ko. A ku kĩɑ ɑ n kɑ bu wɑ̃ɑ.
Domi bɑ rɑ kɑ̃wɑ bɑ n tɔmbu dɑm dɔremɔ, kpɑ bɑ n ɡerumɔ kɔ̃sɑ ye bɑ koo ko.
Lɑsɑbuwɑ bɑ rɑ kɑ yɛnu bɑni. Bwisiyɑ bɑ rɑ kɑ ɡe tɑ̃sisie.
Yɛ̃rɑ bɑ rɑ kɑ ɡen diɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ ɡeenu kɑ ɑrumɑni yibie.
Wi u bwisi kɑ yɛ̃ru mɔ, wiyɑ u dɑm mɔ.
N weenɛ ɑ lɑsɑbu ko ɑ sere tɑbu dɑ. Tɔn dɑbinun bwisi kɛ̃ɛ ɡeeru tɑ koo de ɑ nɑsɑrɑ wɑ.
Gɑri bɔkɔ kun kpɛ̃ u bwisin ɑsɑnsi ɡiɑ. Yen sɔ̃nɑ u ǹ kpɛ̃ u ɡɑri ɡere mi bɑ sirimɔ.
Wi u rɑ n kɔ̃sɑ bwisikumɔ u koo yĩsiru yɑri kɔ̃sɑn kobu sɔɔ.
Gɑri bɔkɔn bwisikunu rɑ n durum wuuwɑwɑ. Wi u rɑ mɑɑ tɔnu yɑɑkoru ko, bɑ rɑ n nùn tusɑwɑ.
À n tɛmɑnɑbu kpɑnɑ wɑhɑlɑ sɔɔ, ɑ wunɛn dɑm sɑriru sɔ̃ɔsiwɑ mi.
A kookɑri koowo ɑ be bɑ ǹ ɡɑ̃ɑnu kue wɔrɑ be bɑ kɑ dɔɔ bu ɡo.
Kɑɑ kpĩ ɑ weesu ko ɑ nɛɛ, ɑ ǹ yɛ̃ ye n koorɑ, ɑdɑmɑ Gusunɔ u yɛ̃ ye n koorɑ, domi u rɑ tɔnun ɡɔ̃ru wɛ̃ɛri. U mɛɛrɑ kpuro ye ɑ mɔ̀. U koo bɑɑwure nùn win kookoosun ɑre wɛ̃.
Nɛn bii, ɑ tim dio, domi tim mu wɑ̃, mu koo mɑɑ nun dore.
Nɡe mɛyɑ bwisi yi ko n wɑ̃ wunɛn wɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ. À n yi dendimɔ, kɑɑ kpĩ ɑ n nuku dobu mɔ. Kɑɑ n mɑɑ yĩiyɔbu mɔ wunɛn siɑn sɔ̃.
A ku ɡemɡiin yɛnu yinɑ bɛriɑ. A ku win wɑ̃ɑ yeru wɔri ɑ mwɑ.
Gemɡii u rɑ wɔrumɛ kpɑ Gusunɔ u nùn seeyɑ, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃so, nɔni swɑ̃ɑru tɑ rɑ nùn kɑmiɛwɑ.
A ku de wunɛn ɡɔ̃ru ɡu dorɑ wunɛn yibɛrɛ ù n wɔrumɑ, ǹ kun mɛ ù n sokurɑ.
Domi Gusunɔ ù n wɑ mɛ, sɔrɔkudo u koo win mɔru wunɑ win min di.
A ku tii nɔwiɑ ko kɔ̃sɑn kowobun sɔ̃. A ku mɑɑ ye bɑ mɔn binɛ ko.
Domi kɔ̃sɑn kowobu bɑ ǹ ɡɑ̃ɑnu wɑsi siɑ. Ben wɑ̃ɑrɑ koo kpewɑ tumɑru nɡe fitilɑ ɡe ɡɑ ɡum kpɑ.
Nɛn bii, ɑ de ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ kɑ sinɑ boko nɑsiɑ. A kun wɑ̃ɑ be bɑ bu seesimɔn wuurɔ.
Domi bɑ koo kɑm kowɑ subɑru sɔɔ. Goo kun mɑɑ yɛ̃ sɛɛyɑsiɑ bi Gusunɔ kɑ sinɑ boko bɑ koo bu ko.
Bwisiɡibun bwisi kɛ̃ru
Wee ye bwisiɡibɑ mɑɑ ɡeruɑ. Bɑ nɛɛ, siribun sɑɑ sɔɔ, ɑ ku ɡoon nɔnu mɛɛri.
Wi u tɔn kɔ̃so ɡem wɛ̃, tɔmbu bɑ koo nùn bɔ̃rusi,
ɑdɑmɑ wi u nùn sɛɛyɑsiɑ u ko n wɑ̃ɑ doo nɔɔru sɔɔ, kpɑ tɔmbu bu nùn domɑru kuɑ.
Wi u rɑ nun ɡem sɔ̃, kĩi ɡeerɑ u nun sɔ̃ɔsi mi.
A de ɑ n ɡberu mɔ kpɑ ɑ n yɛ̃ mɛ kɑɑ kpĩ ɑ tii diisiɑ ɑ sere yɛnu swĩi.
A ku wunɛn beruse seedɑ weesuɡiɑ diiyɑ. A ku nùn nɔni wɔ̃ke kɑ wunɛn ɡɑri.
A ku mɑɑ nɛɛ, kɑɑ nùn kuɑ nɡe mɛ u nun kuɑ. Kɑɑ nùn kɔsiɑ nɡe mɛ win dɑɑ yɑ nɛ.
Yikuron dɑɑ
Sɔ̃ɔ teeru nɑ sɑrɑ yikuro ɡɑri bɔkɔ ɡoon resɛm ɡbɑɑrɔ.
Mɑ nɑ deemɑ sɑ̃ki kɑ yɑkɑ kɔ̃susɑ su kpiimɔ bɑɑmɑ, mɑ ten kɑrɑ ye u kuɑ kɑ kpenu yɑ wɔrukɑ.
Mɑ nɑ ye mɛɛrɑ kɑ lɑɑkɑri, yerɑ nɑ bwisi dɔbɑ mi.
Nɑ wɑ ɑ̀ n kpunɑ mɑ ɑ dom mɔndu kuɑ ɑ dweeyɑ fiiko ɑ kun sɔmburu kue,
sɑ̃ɑru tɑ koo nun deemɑwɑ nɡe ɡbɛnɔ, kpɑ yɑ̃ɑru tu nun wɔri nɡe swɑɑ diobu.
